high_level_description: This image captures a stunning night sky filled with countless stars, creating a mesmerizing celestial display. The central focus of the image is the Milky Way galaxy, which appears as a bright, swirling band of light stretching vertically across the frame. The Milky Way's luminous core is particularly prominent, with a dense concentration of stars and cosmic dust giving it a milky, ethereal appearance. The background is a deep, dark blue, indicative of the vastness of space and the absence of light pollution.
